title: EvalRunRecord
description: Schema for one complete eval run record. Required output locations: evidence/eval-results.json (full summary + per-case results of latest run; overwritten each run) and evidence/eval-runs/run-<n>-<timestamp>.json (identical per-run copy; never deleted). An additional eval-results.jsonl log may use this same schema but is not a substitute for the two required JSON files.

runId.description: Monotonically increasing run identifier (integer) or UUID string.

promptVersion.description: Version identifier of the active prompt file (e.g. 'v1').

harnessVersion.description: Version of the eval harness (from package.json or manual tag).

aggregateScore.description: Weighted aggregate score across all non-ERROR cases (0–1).

result.description: Overall eval result against all declared thresholds.

errorCount.description: Total number of ERROR-classified case runs (exit code 4). These are excluded from aggregateScore.

runScores.description: Binary pass/fail (1/0) for each of the 3 runs.

layer2Results.description: Per-run map of INV/PROP/GR identifier → boolean.

layer3Results.description: Per-run map of SEM identifier → boolean, plus semanticScore fraction.

flaky.description: True if the 3 runs produced inconsistent results on intent, priority, due (±1 min), or title meaning.

flakyFields.description: Names of fields that disagreed across runs (e.g. ['intent', 'due']).

errorRuns.description: Number of runs for this case classified as ERROR (exit code 4).
